# Libertinus webfonts

Subset of the [Libertinus font family](https://github.com/alerque/libertinus)
(the maintained successor of Linux Libertine / Linux Biolinum), converted from
the release OTFs to woff2. These are the faces the FIN 30600 beamer lecture
template (`ndcollegiate.sty`) uses: Libertinus Sans for body text, Libertinus
Serif for display titles.
